system.description: Maybe it’s a power suit, maybe a knight’s plate, maybe it’s tough hide. Build from heroes successfully Attacked by Skeeterbots in Scene 1. (1 per DNA-sampled hero of matching archetype.)
system.tactics: Mimic the copied hero; choose two abilities from the listed options, or make one up that mimics something the hero is good at.

system.description: Choose two abilities: Armor: Reduce all damage taken by 1. | Living Shield: +1 to Defend actions. | Powered Exoskeleton: +1 to Overcome actions related to brute force.
